user.title: Connect your Entopizo account
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use on go.entopizo.gr. The password is only used once to obtain an API token and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Entopizo
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {email} is no longer valid (for example after a password change). Enter the account password to issue a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Entopizo API.

abort.already_configured: This Entopizo account is already configured.

data.track_events: Fire entopizo_event for new platform events

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Entopizo API, in seconds.
data_description.track_events: Overspeed, geofence, ignition, SOS and other events generated by your alert rules become Home Assistant events you can use in automations.

device_not_found.message: The selected device is not an Entopizo tracker of a loaded account.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a GPRS command to an Entopizo tracker. Immobilizer commands physically affect the vehicle, so use them with care.

device_id.name: Tracker
device_id.description: The Entopizo tracker to send the command to.

command_type.name: Command type
command_type.description: Command type, e.g. custom or a type supported by the device protocol (engineStop, engineResume, ...).

data.name: Data
data.description: Command payload when the command type is custom, e.g. setdigout 1.
